title: Sitemap commerce sections still stop at 100 rows each with no second page, and help category pages carry no lastmod

source.ref: Remainder of SCAN-1226 (whole-site audit 2026-11-16, project thread, requested by Daniel), split out when the circles half shipped.

detail:
EVIDENCE: app/sitemap.ts COMMERCE_SITEMAP_CAP = 100. listShopProducts, listMarketListings (lib/commerce/products.ts) and listHousingListings (lib/listings/housing.ts) clamp the caller's limit to 100 and take no offset; listListings (lib/marketplace.ts) takes no offset either. The help category entries in app/sitemap.ts carry no lastModified.

WHY IT MATTERS: Past 100 store, market, housing or classified listings the oldest drop out of the sitemap with only a log line (atCap). Volumes are near zero today, so this is not a launch problem. Help categories lose the recrawl hint the pricing and door pages now have.

FIX DIRECTION: Give the four readers an offset or range and walk them the way walkPublicCirclesPast walks circles (SCAN-1226), then drop COMMERCE_SITEMAP_CAP. Stamp help category pages from the newest article date in the category.

UPDATE 2026-11-16 (behaviour shipped, row left OPEN on a probe conflict): the four readers now take an offset (a named offset turns the read into a .range() page ordered by created_at then id; no migration, they are plain table reads) and app/sitemap.ts walks each vertical 100 rows a page through walkCommercePages, up to 50 pages (5,000 rows a vertical), keyed by id, with atCap on that ceiling and a second warning when a page past the first holds nothing new. Help category pages carry the newest article date in the category. Proved in app/sitemap-commerce-walk.test.ts through the real readers.

STILL OPEN, AND WHY: this probe passes only when the text COMMERCE_SITEMAP_CAP = 100 is gone from app/sitemap.ts. The done row SCAN-203 has a probe that fails unless app/sitemap.ts carries COMMERCE_SITEMAP_CAP = <n> with <n> equal to every Math.min(Math.max(.., 1), <n>) clamp in lib/commerce/products.ts and lib/listings/housing.ts, and app/sitemap.test.ts pins the same (the readers are handed exactly 100, and the clamps are 100). So the constant stayed, as the page size of the walk and no longer the cap of the section, the way CIRCLE_SITEMAP_CAP stayed for SCAN-1226. Both probes cannot pass on one tree without moving the clamps off 100 only to dodge the text, or retiming one probe. NEXT: an owner ruling on which pin moves (retime this probe to measure the walk, for example node -e that requires walkCommercePages and the four offset readers; or retire the SCAN-203 constant pin), then close.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16: the commerce sections are still capped. Passes when the cap constant is gone because the readers page.
